projects.title: Dilo como Madrid

credits.label: Scope
credits.value: Creative Direction / Art Direction / Creative Technology / AR / Voice Recognition / Development / Motion

projects.summary: A voice-activated AR experience turning Mahou’s pronunciation into a playful introduction to Madrid.
text: Dilo como Madrid is a voice-activated AR experience that turns the correct pronunciation of Mahou into an interaction across iconic brand murals in Madrid.

Users scan a QR code, point their camera at the mural and pronounce “Mahou.” When the system recognizes the correct pronunciation, the mural comes alive through AR animation and unlocks an invitation to claim a free Mahou at a nearby bar.
I developed the project end-to-end, from concept and creative direction to visual design, animation, voice recognition, AR and development.

projects.title: Beefeater Light

credits.label: Scope
credits.value: Creative Direction / Campaign Concept / Art Direction / Film / Motion Design / AI-Assisted Production / Visual Identity

projects.summary: A campaign concept for Beefeater Light turning its 50% lower alcohol proposition into a visual language rooted in London.
text: Beefeater has always been deeply connected to London — its streets, architecture, culture and attitude. With Beefeater Light offering 50% less alcohol, the challenge was to communicate reduction without making the product feel like a reduced version of the brand.

The campaign turns “half” into the central creative device. London’s most recognizable icons are divided, cropped and reconstructed in halves while remaining instantly identifiable, creating a visual parallel with the product itself.
The idea became a cinematic and graphic campaign system built around a simple message: Half the alcohol. Full London spirit.

projects.title: Airbnb

credits.label: Scope
credits.value: Creative Direction / Campaign Concept / Art Direction / AI Film / Storytelling

projects.summary: A campaign concept for Airbnb built around the gap between what homeowners imagine and what actually happens when they open their door.
text: Opening your home to strangers can make it easy to imagine the worst.

For Airbnb, we turned that fear into the starting point of the campaign. An elderly couple receives a booking from a family with three children and immediately imagines chaos: mess, destruction and everything that could go wrong inside their home.
The campaign is built around the gap between what homeowners imagine could happen and what actually happens when they open their door.
